commitments.target: ensure O-negative and O-positive red cell units are available
commitments.detail: Provide 2 units of O-negative and 2 units of O-positive red cells for the reserve.
Store the reserve at -20°C to -8°C to ensure quality and safety.
Deliver new stock on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
Train 3 nurses by October 15, 2023, on how to handle the emergency blood reserve.
